sar.narrative: On November 30, 2016, through December 2, 2016, card C07987-K2 associated with customer C07987 generated four transactions totaling $360.74. The activity includes an in-person transaction of $116.91 (ID 3499109) on November 30, 2016, and an online transaction of $99.92 (ID 3503878) on December 1, 2016. Two additional in-person transactions occurred on December 2, 2016: $35.87 (ID 3507926) and $108.04 (ID 3508124). The online transaction was executed from a device profiled as "New" for this account, a factor that elevates the risk assessment. Graph analysis indicates the device is shared with cards C01104-K2, C01983-K1, C06224-K2, and C11309-K1, suggesting potential coordinated misuse. The heuristic engine assigned a fraud probability of 0.86 and identified the pattern as account takeover. This activity is suspicious because the new device usage combined with mixed-channel transactions deviates from the cardholder's established history. Customer C07987 has a history of 128 transactions with a mean amount of $225.92 across various regions. Previous closed cases CC-2011, CC-2860, and CC-5026 for this customer resulted in confirmed fraud findings. The current exposure of $360.74 exceeds the threshold for automatic closure, necessitating further investigation. The presence of a new device alongside shared device indicators supports the hypothesis of compromised credentials.
